analysis.investment_thesis: Desco Infra fails the Magic Formula on the critical quality dimension — a 0.26% ROE indicates near-zero return on capital, which no valuation discount can compensate for. A P/E of 10.4 looks cheap on the surface, but cheap + bad business is a value trap, not a bargain.
key_strengths: Optically low P/E of 10.4 (~9.6% earnings yield on equity)
Exposure to secular CGD/renewables/water infra themes
key_risks: ROE of 0.26% implies return on capital is effectively zero — fails Magic Formula quality test
Civil construction is capital-intensive with working-capital drag, suppressing ROIC
Micro-cap (INR 124 Cr) with negligible DII (2.2%) and zero FII — no institutional validation
red_flags: ROE of 0.26% is a near-fatal quality signal
P/E of 10.4 paired with sub-1% ROE suggests earnings are either one-off or book value is inflated
EPC contractors often show P/E on peak-cycle earnings that don't reflect through-cycle ROIC
analysis.detailed_analysis:
The Magic Formula ranks companies jointly on earnings yield (cheapness) and return on capital (quality). Desco scores acceptably on the first — a P/E of 10.4 implies roughly a 9.6% earnings yield on equity, borderline attractive. But ROE of 0.26% is catastrophic: for every rupee of shareholder capital, the company earned a quarter of a paisa. Return on capital will be in the same ballpark given civil construction's asset + working-capital intensity. A business earning 0% on capital destroys value even if you buy it cheap — time works against you, not for you.

The promoter holding of 58.31% is a mild positive, but institutions have voted with their feet (0% FII, 2.2% DII) and at INR 124 Cr market cap this is a thinly-covered micro-cap in a sector (EPC civil construction) where ROIC is structurally poor outside a handful of best-in-class operators (L&T, KNR, PNC). Until Desco demonstrates sustained ROCE >18-20% for multiple years, the Magic Formula says pass — there are far better combinations of cheap + good elsewhere in the Indian small-cap universe.
